description: This Dart source file defines the DownloadController class, which manages download-related actions and state coordination between the UI and the download engine within a Flutter application. It provides methods for restoring download state, refreshing data, enqueueing new downloads, cancelling downloads, and querying download records.

classes.name: DownloadController
classes.description: A controller class that manages the download state and actions, facilitating communication between the UI layer and the download engine.

methods.name: restoreFromDisk
methods.description: Restores the download state from the engine, currently by listing downloads from the engine, with placeholder for future persistence implementation.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the in-memory list of downloads from the download engine.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a new download with specified content ID and title.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing download by content ID.

methods.name: findByContentId
methods.description: Retrieves a download record by its content ID if it exists.
